description: [``botocore``] Launch CloudFront in AWS European Sovereign Cloud.

[``botocore``] This release adds support for KVSHQ API in the AWS European Sovereign Cloud. Requests for key value stores in the aws-eusc partition are now routed to account-based endpoints under cloudfront-kvs.global.api.amazonwebservices.eu.

[``botocore``] Release of the new integration type in CreateIntegration API - Used to add Microsoft Azure resources to the Amazon CloudWatch Omni context graph through an AWS Config connector for your Azure tenant.
[``botocore``] Update endpoint-rules client to latest version
[``botocore``] Adds support for new FSx for NetApp ONTAP resources
